regions.merged_text: God bless you Grace and many thanks for your favor. I've mis- laid your letter just for the moment; but before neglecting it further and then forgetting I am just sending this card that Br. Rufin started. Please give "Best Regards" to George and and to Mother especially and to Doris. I hope these latter will enjoy their trip to Wisconsin and get back in good shape. Thank Doris also for her favor of last week.
